nodes.name: SelectGhostTrigger.tsx
nodes.summary: Ghost-variant trigger component that visually matches Select's small/ghost/lg configuration, for custom droplists (e.g. Dropdown droplist mode, spotlight palette) that need the compact workstation-header select look without adopting Select's built-in option panel.
nodes.languageNotes: Renders via the shared Button component with a class-name reset rather than a raw <button>, since Button's own ghost appearance doesn't match Select's ghost styling.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Defines shared configuration constants for the Select component: a radius-to-Tailwind-class mapping and the default prop values.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Main Select form component: a thin trigger wrapper (selector box, tags, search input, clear button, chevron) that delegates dropdown positioning/keyboard behavior to shared Dropdown engine hooks and renders options via DropdownOptionsRenderer.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript type definitions for the Select component, including SelectOption/SelectOptionGroup aliases shared with Dropdown and the full SelectProps interface.

nodes.name: useSelect.ts
nodes.summary: Custom hook managing Select's controlled/uncontrolled value state, flattened option lookup, and single/multiple selection and clear handlers, while delegating dropdown positioning/keyboard behavior to the Dropdown module.

nodes.name: SelectGhostTrigger
nodes.summary: React forwardRef component that renders a ghost-styled Button trigger with label content and an animated chevron icon, reused by custom droplists needing Select's compact appearance.

nodes.name: Select
nodes.summary: forwardRef component implementing the Select UI: manages search filtering, panel positioning via a portal, tag display for multi-select, and keyboard/mouse interactions by composing useSelect, useDropdownEngine, and useDropdownKeyboard.

nodes.name: useSelect
nodes.summary: Hook that resolves controlled vs. internal value state, flattens grouped options, computes the currently selected option(s), and exposes handleSelect/handleClear callbacks for single and multiple selection modes.
